answers.goal: My ultimate goal is to be a political reporter covering Congress or the White House for a television station.
answers.drew: Watching The Dropout on Hulu showed me the intersection between journalism and television through the dramatic telling of fraud and corruption in what was thought of as one of the most forward looking healthcare companies. As a journalist, I think storytelling is so critical in all forms whether that be on a news channel, via social media, or through a docudrama.
answers.seeking: I'm looking to connect with people in the entertainment industry who are passionate about telling stories. As a journalist, I recognize that everyone has a story to tell and such a unique creative vision and I look forward to connecting with interns across LA.
answers.inspiration: One of my biggest inspirations is Kaitlan Collins. She joined CNN in 2017 at 25 and currently anchors a nightly primetime news show in addition to being the channels White House Correspondent.
